text: Confirmed from the repo, with one limit. Design: 3 accounts, one scheduled Claude session each, daily at 07:20, 13:20 and 19:20 ET. The duty rotates by date: ANALYST (study scanned/placed bets and bids, CLV first, change filters/sizes within the evidence rules), ENGINEER (fix and ship app, engine and workflow changes) and WATCH (check the engine is running and trading, fix stalls). Between them GitHub runs for free: the engine, the daily digest, twice-daily grading, the dataset builds and a watchdog. Limit: I can only see this account's routine. I can't see the other two accounts' schedules or usage from here; the only proof is the coordination board, and a missed slot is covered by the next account that runs. Today's slots are on the board; this account's current slot (WATCH) is the one answering you now. If you want certainty, the board (tools/coord.py board) lists each run's finished-duty note; I can post the last few days of them here if you'd like.
